name: tadween
description: Tadween social media automation. Schedule posts, manage integrations, upload media, and track analytics across 28+ platforms including X, LinkedIn, Reddit, YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram.

tadween.note: Official Tadween MCP server (hosted, streamable HTTP). Authorizes via OAuth on first connection — the agent is prompted to sign in to Tadween; no token or local install required. Lets the agent manage your social media posts
